notes: Casino: a new 10× button spins the slots 10 times in a row (about 3 seconds), with all ten results lined up; press it again to stop. Blackjack: while a player is dealing, bets are capped at 1,000. A player dealer who busts on purpose (hits on 17 or more, or hits while already beating everyone, then busts) gets a strike; 3 strikes in a day and they're taken off the dealer seat until tomorrow.
